from pathlib import Path
programs=Path('/home/USER/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/stage1/HPL-prime-agent-luna6-high-rnd0/frozen/held-out/play/users/u070/system/state/workspace/programs')
programs.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
program_path=programs/'task-d64c2758.py'
source='''def transform(grid):
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    points = {v: (r, c) for r, row in enumerate(grid) for c, v in enumerate(row) if v in (1, 2)}
    r, c = points[1]
    tr, tc = points[2]
    while abs(tr - r) > 1 or abs(tc - c) > 1:
        dr = (tr > r) - (tr < r)
        dc = (tc > c) - (tc < c)
        if abs(tr - r) > 1 and abs(tc - c) > 1:
            r += dr
            c += dc
        elif abs(tr - r) > 1:
            r += dr
        else:
            c += dc
        out[r][c] = 3
    return out
'''
program_path.write_text(source)
exec(compile(source, str(program_path), 'exec'), globals())
